name: Thumb
say: A thumbs up means something good! God created you, loves you, and wants to have a relationship with you.
pray: What do you want to say to God about His love for you?

vs.t: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
vs.e: For I am conscious of my thoughts about you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you hope at the end.
vs.w: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

vs.t: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
vs.e: For God had such love for the world that he gave his only Son, so that whoever has faith in him may not come to destruction but have eternal life.
vs.w: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

vs.t: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
vs.e: The thief comes only to take the sheep and to put them to death: he comes for their destruction: I have come so that they may have life and have it in greater measure.
vs.w: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

vs.t: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
vs.e: He who overcomes will have these things for his heritage; and I will be his God, and he will be my son.
vs.w: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

name: Index finger
act: Point your index finger at the person and at yourself.
say: Pointing this finger signifies blame. We have all sinned and are separated from God. Sin causes a separation between us and God, and it always points us away from Him.
pray: What do you want to say to God about your sin?

vs.t: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
vs.e: But your sins have come between you and your God, and by your evil doings his face has been veiled from you, so that he will give you no answer.
vs.w: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

vs.t: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the Lord hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
vs.e: We all went wandering like sheep; going every one of us after his desire; and the Lord put on him the punishment of us all.
vs.w: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

vs.t: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
vs.e: For all have done wrong and are far from the glory of God;
vs.w: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

vs.t: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
vs.e: For the reward of sin is death; but what God freely gives is eternal life in Jesus Christ our Lord.
vs.w: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

name: Middle finger
act: Hold your hand open and point to your middle finger.
say: This is the tallest finger. Jesus died and rose again to pay the price for your sin. It is also the ‘rude’ finger, a sign of a curse: Jesus became a curse so you could become righteous. No matter how badly you have sinned, His sacrifice and forgiveness are greater. Jesus won the victory over sin, and now He wants to be Lord of your life, your number one.
pray: What do you want to say to God about what Jesus did for you on the cross?

vs.t: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
vs.e: Christ has made us free from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us: because it is said in the Writings, A curse on everyone who is put to death by hanging on a tree:
vs.w: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

vs.t: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
vs.e: For him who had no knowledge of sin God made to be sin for us; so that we might become the righteousness of God in him.
vs.w: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

vs.t: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
vs.e: Because Christ once went through pain for sins, the upright one taking the place of sinners, so that through him we might come back to God; being put to death in the flesh, but given life in the Spirit;
vs.w: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

vs.t: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
vs.e: Jesus said to him, I am the true and living way: no one comes to the Father but by me.
vs.w: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

name: Ring finger
say: A ring on this finger is the sign of a committed relationship that began with a decision. God invites you into a relationship with Him, but you must accept His invitation. [Hold up your thumb] God has already said “I do”… [point to your ring finger] …now you must say “I do” to Him. Turn away from sin and turn to God! Just as a ring is a symbol of a relationship, baptism is the symbol of a commitment to Jesus.
pray: What do you want to say to God about starting a relationship with Him and obeying Him?

vs.t: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
vs.e: See, I am waiting at the door and giving the sign; if my voice comes to any man's ears and he makes the door open, I will come in to him, and will take food with him and he with me.
vs.w: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.

vs.t: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
vs.e: Jesus said to him in answer, If anyone has love for me, he will keep my words: and he will be dear to my Father; and we will come to him and make our living-place with him.
vs.w: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.

vs.t: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
vs.e: Because, if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead, you will have salvation:
vs.w: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

vs.t: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
vs.e: And Peter said, Let your hearts be changed, every one of you, and have baptism in the name of Jesus Christ, for the forgiveness of your sins; and you will have the Holy Spirit given to you.
vs.w: Peter said to them, “Repent, and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

name: Little finger
act: Hold up your little finger by itself.
say: This is the weakest finger of all. A new believer cannot stand alone. You need someone to help you learn to obey Jesus, and you will soon help others too.

vs.t: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
vs.e: Go then, and make disciples of all the nations, giving them baptism in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:
vs.w: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

vs.t: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
vs.e: Brothers, take me as your example, and take note of those who are walking after the example we have given.
vs.w: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

vs.t: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
vs.e: And the things which I have said to you before a number of witnesses, give to those of the faith, so that they may be teachers of others.
vs.w: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.
